name: Youth Coalition Member (Rocky Mountain Youth Corps)
org: Rocky Mountain Youth Corps of New Mexico
what_you_do: Join the Youth Coalition Member job in Taos, NM. It is part of the Prevention Program.

deadline_text: An earlier listing gave Oct 9, 2026 to Apr 30, 2027. As of Nov 4, 2026 the apply page no longer lists this job.

notes: An earlier listing gave the dates, ages and pay on this card. Hours per week and the last day to apply were not stated. The Prevention Program listing says its positions are for people pursuing a career in public health addressing substance misuse.
